subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu support automatic group sender dynamic agents/subagents, and should that be an opt-in Feishu dynamicAgentCreation mode, a session/binding-only pattern, or a broader plugin/session API?
rationale: The request changes group-chat routing, agent lifecycle, memory and skill isolation, config writes, and shared-user trust boundaries, so automation cannot choose the product and security contract safely.

options.title: Design opt-in group dynamic agents
options.body: Extend Feishu dynamicAgentCreation for group senders behind explicit config, caps, lifecycle cleanup, routing rules, and security documentation.

options.title: Use session scopes and bindings only
options.body: Keep automatic agent creation DM-only and document group_sender/group_topic_sender plus manual bindings as the supported isolation path.

options.title: Defer to a generic plugin/session API
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers define a cross-channel threading or dynamic-agent SDK contract that Feishu can consume.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in group dynamic agents
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu dynamicAgentCreation for group senders behind explicit config, caps, lifecycle cleanup, routing rules, and security documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the most recent current-main Feishu routing and dynamic-agent refactor history for the affected files.
